scope: Visual frontend redesign only. Backend, database, auth, API client, routes and feature business logic were not edited.

direction.override: User-selected CollectiveOS composition, palette, rounded surfaces and capsule navigation take precedence over randomly dealt composition and strict house style.

idea: On this page, PRAVYA’s immutable submission journey becomes the inset interactive workspace in the CollectiveOS composition.
live_thing: Existing Upload, Validate, Review and Activate stage selector; pointer and keyboard tested.
subject_inventory: Independent local validation and identity verification
arguments: Hero: admissions workflow in one workspace, evidenced by the existing interactive journey
Overview: unified evidence and immutable history, evidenced by the existing three principles
Capabilities: what local checks and reviews do, using all existing feature descriptions
Preview: honest workspace layout, with existing missing values retained
Roles: distinct work and permitted scope, using existing four role descriptions
Security: authorization, provenance and explicit decision boundaries
Close: existing design principle and real sign-in destination

allowances.eyebrow: Preserve existing content; reference itself uses capsule section labels.
allowances.numbering: Preserve existing workflow and card labels; reference uses numbered steps.
allowances.outlined-box: Reference uses subtle outlines around white rounded cards; real forms and UI keep their borders.
allowances.few-pictures: Preserve existing PRAVYA content; do not invent product imagery or records to satisfy an unrelated marketing-image minimum.
allowances.no-footage: Reference has no video; no relevant PRAVYA footage was provided.
allowances.small-text: Existing metadata remains subordinate and visible; reference has small labels; main running body is 16px.
allowances.size-count: Working preview, metadata and marketing sections share the existing content, requiring more than five type sizes.
allowances.grey-body: Reference uses muted supporting copy; browser-measured contrast remains readable.
allowances.gradient: CSS curtain-like backdrop recreates the reference visual without downloading its assets.

login_inspection.reason: Existing secondary labels, account role sublines, purpose notice and session help use 11–12px; readable main titles and actions retain their hierarchy.

validation.static_taste_lint: FAIL: intentional reference conventions and preserved labels are flagged by the strict static house-style scan; raw results in static-lint.json. Browser checks use explicit allowances.

limitations: Live API unreachable at 127.0.0.1:8000; Docker engine unavailable. Authenticated dashboards, uploads and server-backed mutations could not be exercised.
The frontend has no existing automated UI regression suite; no test harness was added.
This is a reference-inspired restyle preserving PRAVYA content, not a pixel-identical copy of the agency site.
